scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run start
scripts.db:up: docker inspect jobsearch-mysql >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: MySQL container jobsearch-mysql not found - see README Getting Started.'; exit 1; }; docker start jobsearch-mysql >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo 'Waiting for MySQL to accept connections...'; for i in $(seq 1 30); do docker exec jobsearch-mysql mysqladmin ping --silent >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo 'MySQL is ready.'; exit 0; }; sleep 1; done; echo 'ERROR: MySQL not ready after 30s. Check logs: npm run db:logs'; exit 1
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
